# Question

RQ1: How does socioeconomic index differ across different municipal regions in 
British Columbia?

# Simulate

```{r}
set.seed(1738)

simulated_ses_data <- tibble(
  City = c("Victoria", "Oak Bay", "Vancouver", "Burnaby"),
  Economics = sample(1:100, size = 4),
  Education = sample(1:100, size = 4),
  Health = sample(1:100, size = 4),
  Community = sample(1:100, size = 4),
  SEI = rowMeans(data.frame(Economics, Education, Health, Community))
)

simulated_ses_data
```

The code chunk above runs a simulation that randomly assigns values from 1-100
in domains of income (economics), education level, population health variables, 
and community cohesion variables. The socioeconomic index (SEI) takes scores 
on each of these domains to calculate an overall index and to show scores on
each domain [@bcdata].
